fusions.name: Dragging Tines
fusions.desc: Sets a line of reef tines 6 tiles long for 6 seconds, dealing 24 damage that ignores resistances to every enemy it catches and pulling them toward it.

fusions.name: Gleaning Pass
fusions.desc: Rakes the target, dealing 7 damage and leaving it [Bleeding] for 1 damage a second for 3 seconds, and you heal for 15% of the damage dealt. Holds 4 charges; each use spends one, and each kill restores one.

fusions.name: Sorted Tideline
fusions.desc: Restores 3 stamina a second for 8 seconds.

fusions.name: Tideline Pickings
fusions.desc: When you kill an enemy, you regain 4 health a second for 5 seconds. Once every 10 seconds.
